proof_steps.comparison: Exact relative quotient, connection, full nonreduced base change and primary analytic scope were verified against the six actual primary scans. The topological support D in hypercohomology retains the coefficient quotient by t; it does not replace the full fibre module by O_D.

The residue spectrum and exponential identity force residue zero. Factoring exp(N)-I=Nq(N), q(0) nonzero, supplies the exact nilpotent argument; the connection becomes holomorphic and its flat coordinates bounded.

The primitive generator, proper coherence, torsion-free rank one and smooth-fibre restriction are valid. Postrelease I explicitly checked the missing naming precision: taking determinants of 0→h*Ω¹_Δ(log0)→Ω¹_U(logD)→K¹→0 gives det K¹=ω_U(D)⊗h*ω_Δ(0)^−1, and K²=Λ²K¹. This is the displayed formula; the phrase determinant of the whole complex is replaced.

The printed tangential map subtracts res_i(η)θ/m_i before restriction. Changing the lift by fθ changes the subtracted term by exactly fθ. Its local inverse sends each tangential logarithmic basis form to its quotient class, so it is an actual isomorphism. Its exterior square agrees with the residue map used in the fresh proof. Vanishing boundary residues makes a holomorphic two-form, ruled out by p_g=0.

The exact annulus lower radius and b-sheeted projection follow from x^a y^b=t. The nonzero coefficient gives a uniform positive lower bound on a fixed z-disc, and integration of |dx/x|² diverges logarithmically. The coordinate-unit absorption is explicitly proved in the fresh derivation.
The de Rham cup-product pairing in the horizontal frame equals the positive integral and is bounded. It contradicts the local annular lower bound.

The logarithmic derivative preserves J and (t). The degreewise θ-sequence is locally split, hence its coefficient subquotient gives an exact sequence of complexes and a natural derived endomorphism. The inclusion into O/(t) intertwines it with the actual residue. Proposed wording makes the induced coefficient differential precise.

The surviving integer exponent vectors are a(m_i/e); Bezout for the primitive vector proves that a is integral. J imposes a≥1 and quotienting by t imposes a<e. Nonzero Koszul weights have uniformly bounded inverse denominators, so contractions preserve convergence. The residue a/e is nonzero; e=1 is acyclic.

Residue equivariance holds on the local-to-global hypercohomology spectral sequence. The finite common annihilating polynomial has nonzero constant term; a power annihilates the abutment. Bezout gives an inverse residue operator. Intertwining with zero residue forces the inclusion-induced map to be zero.

The central class factors through the coefficient ideal because Ω vanishes on each branch. Full-fibre base change therefore makes [Ω](0)=0. Dividing its section by t is holomorphic in the locally free bundle.

A generator cannot be divisible by t, so some central order is smaller than its multiplicity. The explicit one-sheet local volume bound for Ω/t has negative exponent 2(b_i/m_i−1), while the flat-frame cup pairing stays bounded. The fresh proof uses the equivalent inequality for Ω versus O(|t|²), with multiplication by |t|² providing the exact transport between the inequalities.
The cup map Λ²H¹→H² is proved by invariant lattice-dual one-forms and coordinate two-tori. Naturality makes it monodromy equivariant, so identity in H¹ would force identity in H².
